title: Common
description: Shared types used by every message. Each $defs entry becomes a named type in TypeScript and Go.

Id.title: Id
Id.description: Opaque identifier (user, space, room, stream, device, slot, offer, connection). Clients never parse it.

UnixMs.title: UnixMs
UnixMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

ProtocolVersion.title: ProtocolVersion
ProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version. Peers with the same major version interoperate; minor versions only add.

ClientKind.title: ClientKind
ClientKind.description: What is on the other end of the WebSocket.

RoomVisibility.title: RoomVisibility
RoomVisibility.description: space: every member of the space; restricted: only users listed in room_access.

Preset.title: Preset
Preset.description: Quality preset: text = text and code, game, max = 1440p60, native = native resolution up to 4K60; since 1.8 game120 = 1080p120 and max120 = 1440p120, with only the top simulcast layer at 120 fps.

VideoCodec.title: VideoCodec
VideoCodec.description: A video codec (since 1.14). Every stream publishes H.264; a stream may also publish its top layer in AV1 on a second video track, which only viewers whose browser decodes AV1 pull, on the top layer.

PointerColor.title: PointerColor
PointerColor.description: Closed palette for a pointer ping (since 1.20).

VoiceShortcutAction.title: VoiceShortcutAction
VoiceShortcutAction.description: What a global voice shortcut of the helper does in the web's voice session (since 1.21).

PointerShape.title: PointerShape
PointerShape.description: Closed list of pointer ping shapes (since 1.20).

PointerStyle.title: PointerStyle
PointerStyle.description: How a viewer's pointer ping looks (since 1.20).

PauseReason.title: PauseReason
PauseReason.description: source_hidden: the captured window is minimized or hidden; privacy_curtain: the streamer hid the image; user: paused from the web.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: Free text chosen by a user or read from the OS (display name, window title). Never generated by the server.

Permissions.title: Permissions
Permissions.description: What the connection may do in this room, computed by can() on the server.

canModerate.description: End other people's streams and change their viewer limits; since 1.10 also server-mute others and take them out of the voice channel; since 1.12 also turn their camera off (never the owner or, for an admin, another admin).

canJoinVoice.description: Join the voice channel and listen: the room has voice (since 1.10).

canSpeak.description: Publish a microphone in the voice channel: canJoinVoice, and for a guest the room's guestsCanSpeak (since 1.10). A server mute is separate (VoiceParticipant.serverMuted).

canUseCamera.description: Turn a camera on in the voice channel: the room has the camera capability (with voice), and for a guest the room's guestsCanUseCamera (since 1.12).

canReadChat.description: Read the room's text chat and its history: the room has text (since 1.11).

canWriteChat.description: Send, and edit one's own, chat messages: canReadChat, and for a guest the room's guestsCanWrite (since 1.11). Deleting someone else's message needs canModerate.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: A user present in the room (one entry per user, however many connections they have).

You.title: You
You.description: The receiving connection's own identity and permissions.

expiresAt.description: Hard expiry of a quick room. Absent for fixed rooms.

RoomSettings.title: RoomSettings
RoomSettings.description: Effective limits of the room, already reduced by the platform and space ceilings.

capabilities.description: What the room has, already reduced by what the platform and the space allow (since 1.9). Absent from older servers: the room is stream-only.

maxVoiceParticipants.description: Most people in the voice channel at once (since 1.10, default 12). Voice does not use viewer slots.

guestsCanSpeak.description: Whether guests may speak in the voice channel; they may always listen (since 1.10; default true). A room setting.

maxCameras.description: Most cameras on at once in the voice channel (since 1.12, default 6). Cameras cost egress: every camera is pulled by everyone else in voice.

guestsCanUseCamera.description: Whether guests may turn a camera on (since 1.12, default false). A room setting.

chatRetentionDays.description: How long the text chat keeps messages (since 1.11; default 30). A room setting within the space's ceiling. In a quick room the chat ends with the room whatever this says.

guestsCanWrite.description: Whether guests may write in the text chat; they may always read it (since 1.11; default true). A room setting.

av1Presets.description: The presets whose streams also publish an AV1 track, for viewers that decode AV1 (since 1.14). Absent or empty: H.264 only. Set by the platform admin ("Allow AV1", then a codec choice per preset); always within allowedPresets.

av1QualityPresets.description: Since 1.17: the presets among av1Presets whose AV1 track sends as much as the H.264 top layer, for a sharper picture ("AV1: quality"). The other av1Presets save data: their AV1 track sends about 65 % of it. Absent or empty: every AV1 preset saves data.

Capability.title: Capability
Capability.description: A room capability: stream = the stream grid and player, voice = the voice channel, camera = cameras in the voice channel (needs voice), text = the text chat. Since 1.9.

RoomCapabilities.title: RoomCapabilities
RoomCapabilities.description: Which capabilities are on. A room chooses at least one of stream, voice and text, and camera only with voice; what it effectively has may be less when its space or the platform stopped allowing something. Since 1.9.

VoiceParticipant.title: VoiceParticipant
VoiceParticipant.description: Someone in the room's voice channel, as everyone in the room sees them (since 1.10). One entry per user: a user is in voice from one tab at a time.

muted.description: The user's own mute; always true while deafened or unable to speak.

deafened.description: Not listening (and muted), like Discord's deafen.

serverMuted.description: Muted by a moderator for everyone (voice.serverMute): the room closed their microphone track and refuses a new one until lifted.

camera.description: Their camera is on: published, and pulled by the others in voice (since 1.12; absent means off).

VoiceTrack.title: VoiceTrack
VoiceTrack.description: A microphone published in the voice channel (since 1.10). trackId is opaque and changes when the user publishes again; pull it with POST /api/rtc/rooms/:id/voice/subscribe. SFU session and track names are never sent.

CameraTrack.title: CameraTrack
CameraTrack.description: A camera published in the voice channel (since 1.12): one simulcast video with its layers, highest first (h = 360p, l = 180p). Pull it with POST /api/rtc/rooms/:id/camera/subscribe on the low layer for the strip, and switch to the high one with PUT .../camera/layer when it is enlarged. trackId changes when the user publishes again; SFU session and track names are never sent.

rids.description: The simulcast layers, highest first; empty when the camera is not simulcast.

ChatRetentionDays.title: ChatRetentionDays
ChatRetentionDays.description: Text chat retention in days (since 1.11): 0 = no history (the messages go when the room empties), 7, 30 (the default) or 90.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A message of the room's text chat (since 1.11). Plain text: clients never render it as HTML.

id.description: Unique in the room; later messages sort after earlier ones.

userId.description: The author. Absent when the platform admin deleted the account and chose to keep its messages anonymized ("account removed").

authorName.description: The author's display name when the message was sent; empty for a removed account.

editedAt.description: Set once the author edited the message.

mentions.description: The users the text mentions (@name), resolved by the room.

ChatSummary.title: ChatSummary
ChatSummary.description: This user's place in the room's text chat (since 1.11, welcome.chat).

unread.description: Messages by others after lastReadId (capped at 99+, sent as 100).

lastReadId.description: The last message this user marked as read (chat.read), from any tab.

SourceInfo.title: SourceInfo
SourceInfo.description: What is being streamed, as shown on the stream card.

Track.title: Track
Track.description: A track published to the SFU. A simulcast video track is one track with several encodings (rids).

rids.description: Simulcast encodings, highest first. Absent or empty when not simulcast.

codec.description: The video track's codec (since 1.14); absent means h264. An AV1 track is the stream's top layer alone, without rids: the SFU cannot switch layers inside an AV1 simulcast track.

QualityCap.title: QualityCap
QualityCap.description: Economy mode: the most a stream may publish while the instance's usage is above 90 % of its monthly limit. The helper fits its preset and bitrate under it; viewers start on the middle layer.

VideoLayer.title: VideoLayer
VideoLayer.description: One simulcast layer of a stream's H.264 video track as the helper encodes it (since 1.19): the size after fitting the source's aspect ratio (a 3440x1440 monitor on the native preset is 3440x1440, not 3840x2160), the frame rate after any cap to the display's rate, and the encoder's target bitrate after the room's cap. The AV1 track, when there is one, is the top layer's size and frame rate.

kbps.description: Target bitrate; the helper's rate control may send less.

VideoLayers.title: VideoLayers
VideoLayers.description: The video track's simulcast layers, highest first, in the order of its rids (since 1.19).

StreamInfo.title: StreamInfo
StreamInfo.description: A live stream as every member of the room sees it. SFU session and track details are not included: the Worker hands them out only to viewers holding a slot.

pauseReason.description: Present only when paused is true.

thumbnailAt.description: When the stream's latest thumbnail was stored, which is also its version: GET /api/streams/:streamId/thumbnail?v=<thumbnailAt>. Absent while there is none.

qualityCap.description: Present while economy mode caps the stream.

layers.description: What the helper really encodes (since 1.19), from stream.announce and stream.update. Absent from an older helper: clients fall back to the preset's nominal layers.

pings.description: Viewers may send visual pointer pings on this stream (since 1.20). Absent means false.

pingOverlay.description: The publishing helper can draw pointer pings (since 1.20, from stream.announce). Absent means false.

HelperInfo.title: HelperInfo
HelperInfo.description: A paired helper that is connected to the user's hub.

SourceDescriptor.title: SourceDescriptor
SourceDescriptor.description: A screen or window the helper can capture. On Wayland the portal shows its own picker, so the list may hold one placeholder entry per kind.

hasAudio.description: Per-app audio can be captured for this source.

restored.description: Since 1.3. Starting this source shares the screen or window chosen earlier in the system dialog again, without showing the dialog.

HelperStreamStatus.title: HelperStreamStatus

streamId.description: Absent until the room has accepted stream.announce.

audioApp.description: Since 1.16: whose audio the stream captures (a shared window's app). Absent without app audio.

HelperStreamStatus.description: The helper's current stream. A helper streams one source at a time.

HelperAudioApp.title: HelperAudioApp
HelperAudioApp.description: The app whose audio a stream captures (since 1.16): its name as the OS gives it, its process and, when it looks like a web browser, the browser family. The web warns when that is the browser it plays voice in.

BrowserFamily.title: BrowserFamily
BrowserFamily.description: A web browser's engine family (since 1.16): chromium (Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Edge, Opera, Vivaldi), firefox (and its forks), webkit (GNOME Web, Safari).

VoiceSink.title: VoiceSink
VoiceSink.description: The helper's virtual speaker for voice playback (since 1.16): app-audio capture never takes what is played into it, and it plays on the user's speakers. The web finds it among the browser's audio outputs by label.

label.description: The device's description, what browsers list as the output's label.

VoicePresence.title: VoicePresence
VoicePresence.description: Someone in a room's voice channel, as the space sidebar shows them (since 1.13).

muted.description: Muted by themselves, deafened, unable to speak, or server-muted.

camera.description: Their camera is on (absent means off).

LivePresence.title: LivePresence
LivePresence.description: A stream in a room, as the space sidebar shows it (since 1.13).

displayName.description: Absent only while the streamer has no socket in the room (helper grace period).

paused.description: The stream is paused (absent means live).

RoomPresence.title: RoomPresence
RoomPresence.description: Who is in a room's voice channel and who streams there: the summary a RoomDO pushes to its SpaceDO (since 1.13). Both lists empty means the room is quiet.
